about: Canned answers of chatq-brain --mock for the four model-tier tasks (SPEC.md section 6). The mock has no model and no regex stand-in for these tasks; it answers these labels for any tail, tier "model", why "mock:<task>@1". The regex-tier tasks (fail_kind, extract) run the real regex layer in the mock. Every labels object validates against schemas/<task>@1.json (tests/contract.rs).
